name: Is artificial turf safe for pets and children?

mainEntity.name: Is artificial turf safe for pets and children?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, artificial turf is generally safe for pets and children. Modern artificial grasses are made from non-toxic, lead-free materials, making them suitable for areas where families and pets play. The turf provides a consistent, cushioned surface that can reduce scrapes and falls compared to uneven natural ground. For pets, artificial turf eliminates mud and common outdoor allergens. Pet-specific turf options often feature enhanced drainage systems and antimicrobial infills to help manage odors and maintain hygiene. Regular rinsing is recommended to keep the area clean and fresh.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern artificial turf is safe for pets and children, made from non-toxic materials, offering a clean, consistent play surface while reducing mud and allergens.
